name: The Offering of Blood

angles.text: Warlocks are well-accustomed to dark rites and bargaining with souls, though even seasoned practitioners of the fel might feel a chill at performing a blood sacrifice at an ancient, unknown stone.
Priests concerned with the fate of departed spirits will find the use of a tortured soul in an ominous blood ritual morally unsettling, regardless of whether it puts the entity to rest.

faq.answer: The Offering of Blood takes place at the Offering Stone located within Beren's Peril in Silverpine Forest. The area is fraught with peril and shadowed by dark, lingering magic.
faq.q: Where does this ritual take place?

faq.answer: The Offering Stone is a mysterious ancient monument situated in Beren's Peril. It demands a dark ritual—specifically an offering of blood from a willing sacrifice—to unlock or drain the power slumbering within it.

The ritual requires a Tortured Soul, acting as the 'willing sacrifice' mentioned in recovered note scraps. The soul is presented at the Offering Stone to fulfill the blood offering demanded by the ancient relic.
faq.q: What is the Tortured Soul used for?

faq.answer: Upon completing the ritual, the dark energy animating the Offering Stone is completely drained. Devoid of purpose, the rough stone cracks and crumbles apart, leaving behind something glittering among its remnants.
faq.q: What happens when the offering is completed?

faq.answer: The exact origins and ultimate purpose of the stone remain an enigma. Although completing the rite successfully drains the stone's latent energy and destroys it, whoever originally created the monument and for what grand design remains unknown.
faq.q: Who created the stone and why?

aliases: why is it called berens peril
faq.answer: Beren's Peril is a rocky landmark in Silverpine Forest known for wild beasts and hidden dangers. The presence of the Offering Stone reveals that dark rites and restless souls have also left their mark upon the place.

sections.body: Deep within the crags of Beren's Peril lies the Offering Stone, an ominous relic waiting for a final, dark transaction. Following clues from discarded note scraps that call for a willing sacrifice, adventurers are led to bring forth the offering of blood needed to satisfy the altar's lingering magic. Approaching the stone with the restless essence brings an overpowering sense of dread.
sections.title: The Final Rite

sections.body: Offering the Tortured Soul to the stone initiates a profound reaction, siphoning the lingering power out of the ancient monument. Rather than awakening a greater terror, the blood ritual exhausts the relic completely. Stripped of its arcane purpose, the rough stone fractures and collapses into rubble, revealing a glittering reward buried inside the shattered fragments.
sections.title: Cracking the Stone

summary: The Offering of Blood is a mysterious ritual performed at the Offering Stone in Beren's Peril. Using a Tortured Soul, adventurers give an offering of blood at the stone, as the scrap of note called for.
